description: Talk on the recent evolution of Argentina's fuel market, held as part of Expo Transporte's conference program.

title: Implementación de la robótica en industrias (Implementation of robotics in industries)
speakers: PhD. Ing. Roberto A. Bunge (UdeSA — Director, Ing. en Inteligencia Artificial / Director, Depto. de Ingeniería); Ing. Javier Mascheroni (PAE — Gerente Ejecutivo, Gestión de Activos)
description: Seminar on how robotics is driving innovation and transformation in industry.

title: Winning the Last Mile as a Competitive Advantage
speakers: Varun Chadha (Associate VP ANZ, FarEye); Steven Ballerini (CEO, ASCLA); Andrew McKenna (Managing Director, McKenna Worldwide / Quantium Solutions Australia)
description: Executive discussion on how AI, agility and customer-centric strategies are shaping last-mile delivery performance and competitive advantage.

title: Industry Partners Series: Planning for Uncertainty in Engineering Careers
speakers: Mark Everingham (Founder, Personal Risk Professionals); Richard Hopwood (PPS Mutual)
description: Webinar on financial planning and personal insurance for engineers — income protection, TPD, life and trauma cover, how policy structure (inside vs. outside super) affects tax and claims, and the risks of relying on default super cover.

title: Thought Leaders Series: Secure, Agile Networks — Shaping the Future of Industries
speakers: G. Spurring (Nexon Asia Pacific); Ali Ramti (Bright Food)
description: Webinar on modern network and security strategy — SD-WAN, SASE and AI-driven threat detection, with a case study on Bright Food's phased network transformation (security hardening, redesign for distributed work, then SD-WAN/SSE rollout for remote and OT environments).

title: Thought Leaders Series: Data Insight — A Key Strategy for Energy Management
description: Webinar on data-driven energy management — EMS architecture (metering, communication, software), Australian regulatory standards (NCC, NABERS, Green Star), a seven-pillar framework for energy data strategy, and typical ROI/payback for energy management investment (10–30% savings, 1–3 year payback).

title: Early Career CPD: Strengthening Negotiation Skills to Create Win-Win Solutions
speakers: Jahan Kay (Learning Designer, Engineering Education Australia)
description: Session on negotiation as a tool for early-career engineers — defining negotiation, understanding power dynamics, different communication styles, and building win-win outcomes through shared interests.

title: Ignite Kick-off
description: First of a three-part networking series connecting industry leaders with early-career engineers, focused on mentorship and professional connection within the engineering community.

title: Thought Leaders Series: AI Readiness — Strategy, Technology, and Human Factor
speakers: Rita Arrigo (Strategic Engagement Manager, National AI Centre); Dr Sarah Dods (Advanced Analytics and AI Leader, GHD Digital); Cate Trotter (Senior Manager, Human Centred Design, GHD Digital)
description: Panel on AI adoption for engineers — the six pillars of AI readiness (based on ISO 42001), translating AI strategy into practice while managing risk, and the human/cultural factors driving successful technology integration.

title: Fundamentals of Generative AI (GenAI) for Engineers
speakers: Professor Eduard Hovy (Executive Director, Melbourne Connect); Jenny Mitchell (General Manager, Policy and Advocacy, Engineers Australia)
description: Introductory session on Generative AI and LLMs for engineers — foundational concepts, current capabilities and limitations, ethical/security/regulatory considerations, and findings from an EA report on how GenAI is transforming the engineering profession and workforce.

title: Thought Leaders Series: Industry 4.0 and Beyond in Advanced Manufacturing
speakers: Volker Richter (BMW Group); A/Prof David Holmes (QUT)
description: Webinar on BMW's 'Lean, Green, Digital' iFactory vision — how sustainability and digitisation in advanced manufacturing are extending Lean principles under Industry 4.0, and their role as a foundation for emerging Industry 5.0 concepts.

title: Offshore Wind Power Generation in Australia
speakers: Chris Amos (Technical Director, Sustainability & Climate Change, Aurecon Australasia)
description: Presentation on offshore wind development in Australia, drawing on the presenter's experience with a Gippsland offshore wind feasibility licence application — development/construction tasks, supply chain, ports, grid connection, and workforce challenges, plus a comparison with onshore wind.

title: 3D Bioprinting for Regenerative Medicine
speakers: Deanna Hood (Senior Robotics Engineer, Inventia Life Science; Young Professional Engineer of the Year)
description: Presentation on applying electrical/software engineering to life sciences — Deanna Hood's work on Inventia's Ligō skin-printing robot, IEC 60601-1 compliance strategies for medical robotics, and her broader career journey across bioprinting, burns treatment, and assistive robotics.

title: Risk Mitigation and Management — Fundamentals of Risk Management

title: Global Engineering Talent Networking Series: Planning for Career Progression

title: Achieving Advanced Insights with BigQuery
description: Course on advanced BigQuery — SQL functions beyond the basics, how BigQuery's architecture addresses the scaling limits of traditional databases, query performance optimization, and permission-control/data-sharing tools within Google Cloud.

title: Creating New BigQuery Datasets and Visualizing Insights
description: Second course in Google Cloud's 'From Data to Insights' specialization — creating permanent/temporary tables from query results, loading and creating new BigQuery datasets, SQL JOINs vs. UNIONs across multiple data sources, and building dashboards/visualizations in Google Data Studio.

title: Exploring and Preparing Your Data with BigQuery
description: First course in Google Cloud's 'From Data to Insights' specialization — core big data tools on Google Cloud, querying with SQL basics in BigQuery, understanding BigQuery pricing/query optimization, and building an automated data cleansing pipeline, including hands-on work with a real Google Analytics e-commerce dataset.

title: Statistics is the Crown Jewel of Data Science (Belz Lecture)
org: Data Science Melbourne / Statistical Society of Australia
speakers: Antony Ugoni (Global Matching and Analytics Director, SEEK)
description: Annual Belz Lecture on the importance of staying grounded in core statistics as data science applications advance — ANOVA, randomness, the Central Limit Theorem, and hypothesis testing as foundational concepts underpinning the field.

title: RMIT Hack the Future: Mixed Reality Hackathon — powered by Microsoft
description: Two-day hackathon bringing together students and hobbyists across disciplines to reinvent how we learn using Microsoft's HoloLens and Windows Mixed Reality.
